title: Fire Emblem: The Sacred Stones

widgets.text: Units in roster order (deploy order). Weapon ranks: E 1, D 31, C 71, B 121, A 181, S 251 points.

Weapon triangle: swords beat axes, axes beat lances, lances beat swords (+hit/+dmg). Anima beats light, light beats dark, dark beats anima. Bows deal triple-like damage to fliers; armour-slaying, horse-slaying and reaver weapons flip the matchups.
widgets.title: Tips

widgets.text: Each unit carries 5 items; extras go to the convoy (Merlinus / the supply wagon). Vulneraries heal 10 HP, Elixirs full; Door/Chest keys or a Thief open locks. Stat boosters: Angelic Robe (HP), Energy Ring (Str), Secret Book (Skl), Speedwing (Spd), Goddess Icon (Lck), Dracoshield (Def), Talisman (Res), Body Ring (Con).

Recruit by talking: Colm (Neimi), Marisa (Gerik), Joshua (Natasha), Cormag (Eirika/Ephraim), Rennac (pay him), Amelia (Ephraim/Franz/Duessel), Knoll, Dozla, Saleh/Ewan. Creature Campaign and Tower/Ruins unlock extra characters after the ending.

Prologue + 8 shared chapters, then Eirika's or Ephraim's route (chapters 9-15), joined again for the finale (16-20). After the ending: the Tower of Valni and the Lagdou Ruins, and the world map lets you fight skirmishes to level up.
